# Drivee

> Drivee is an independent, Toronto-built web app for drivers in Ontario, Canada. It does two things: (1) helps drivers handle parking and traffic tickets - scan a ticket with AI, get a plain-English verdict on whether to pay or dispute it, with deadline reminders and free guided dispute forms; (2) provides vehicle history: a free VIN check (specs, open recalls, market value estimate, known weak points by make) and a paid full vehicle history report.

Key facts:
- Website: https://www.drivee.ca
- Service area: Toronto and Ontario, Canada (ticket tools are Toronto-specific; VIN check works for any North American VIN)
- The free VIN check decodes any 17-character VIN using the NHTSA vPIC government database and shows open safety recalls, an estimated market value and the make's documented weak points. No sign-up required.
- The full vehicle history report costs $19 CAD (accident and damage history, odometer readings with rollback check, previous owners, theft records) or $30 CAD including an Ontario lien check. Reports are delivered by email.
- In Ontario, lien information is also available directly from ServiceOntario in the Used Vehicle Information Package (UVIP, about $20).
- The ticket scanner reads Toronto parking and traffic tickets and explains options and deadlines in plain English; the Early Resolution guided wizard is free.
- Drivee is independent and not affiliated with CARFAX, NHTSA, the City of Toronto, MTO or any law firm.
- Contact: drivee.canada@gmail.com

- [Parking signs guide](https://www.drivee.ca/parking-signs/): how to read Toronto parking signs

## Frequently cited answers

- Toronto parking ticket late fees: day 16 adds a $15.39 address search fee, day 31 adds a $32.10 late payment fee, day 60 adds a $32.10 plate denial fee.
- Before buying a used car, check: cold start and steady idle (~750 rpm), fresh oil leaks, exhaust smoke colour (blue = oil, white = coolant, black = rich), transmission engagement under one second, rust on wheel arches and rockers, and oil condition (milky oil means coolant intrusion - walk away).
- A VIN is 17 characters and never contains the letters I, O or Q.
